business.what_it_does: Large deposit-funded bank. Deposits grew 18.8% YoY in Q2 FY27 (4 percentage points of that from a special FCNR(B) window), and it added 1.7 million liability relationships in the quarter. Its lending includes an unsecured book, business banking, corporate and agri loans; the corporate bank grew 16.4% YoY. About 70% of the loan book is floating-rate. TTM revenue is INR359,956 crore and TTM PAT INR83,685 crore.

segments.name: Liabilities (deposits / CASA)
segments.comment: Total deposits +18.8% YoY; CASA +10.8%; retail CASA +11.2% against 9% a year ago (C1).

segments.name: Corporate bank
segments.comment: +2.8% QoQ, +16.4% YoY (C3). Loan-mix share not stated.

segments.name: Business banking
segments.comment: Guided to grow 18-21% (G4). The inputs report no actual growth figure.

segments.name: Agri
segments.comment: Agri gross NPA was flat from June to September despite the monsoon shortfall (C2).

credibility.label: medium
credibility.summary: Too early to score. The inputs hold four guidance items (NIM direction, December repricing, unsecured-book provision coverage, business-banking growth) and none can be tested against reported numbers. Management also declined to size the Q1 FY27 mobilisation drive (C4), so its guidance here is directional rather than numeric.

promises.evidence: The October 2026 25 bps rate change is due to be largely reflected in margins by December, given about 70% of the book is floating. Q3 FY27 has not been reported.
The inputs report no provision-coverage ratio for the unsecured book. No horizon was given.
The inputs report no business-banking growth. The only segment growth disclosed is the corporate bank at 16.4% YoY (C3), a different segment.
The inputs give no NIM series. Cost of funds was flat at 4.4% QoQ because FCNR time deposits offset back-book repricing (C3). Reported margin was 30.1% in Q2 against 30.6% a year earlier.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: The liabilities franchise is 'delivering with great vigor': deposits up 18.8% YoY (C1).
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: 4 percentage points of that came from the special FCNR(B) window, so underlying growth was about 14.8%. CASA grew only 10.8%. Of the 1.57 trillion of deposit growth, about 1.3 trillion (83%) was time deposits, which kept cost of funds flat at 4.4% instead of falling (C3).

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Margins can be neutral to positive from here as floating-rate repricing offsets the FCNR cost headwind (G1, G2).
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Q2 revenue growth picked up to 9.4% YoY after 2.4%, 0.5% and 3.7% in the prior three quarters, but PAT grew only 5.8% and reported margin was 30.1% against 30.6% a year earlier. The December repricing has not been reported yet.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: No sign of agri stress despite the monsoon shortfall; kharif sowing was down only about 1.5-2% (C2).
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Agri gross NPA was flat from June to September per management, but the inputs carry no agri NPA number and the crop outcome comes after the harvest.

bull.point: Deposit mobilisation: deposits +18.8% YoY (about 14.8% without FCNR), retail CASA growth up to 11.2% from 9% a year ago, and 1.7 million new liability relationships in Q2.
Revenue reaccelerated to 9.4% YoY in Q2 after three quarters of 0.5-3.7%. The corporate bank grew 16.4% YoY, and the AT1 call in August removed a cost line.
Asset-quality signals are steady: agri gross NPA flat in September against June despite the monsoon shortfall. Management expects the October rate change to reprice about 70% of the book by December.

bear.point: Earnings growth has slowed: Q2 PAT was up only 5.8% YoY against a 3-year PAT CAGR of 19.7%. Reported margin is down 670 bps over three years, and ROE is 14.0%.

Deposit growth is being bought with time deposits: about 1.3 trillion of the 1.57 trillion increase was term deposits, including FCNR, so cost of funds stayed at 4.4% and CASA growth of 10.8% trails total deposits at 18.8%.
Reliance on wholesale funding: borrowings are INR594,144 crore (0.98x equity), and new borrowing to support leverage offset the AT1 call relief.

questions: Of the 1.3 trillion of time-deposit growth, how much is special-window FCNR(B), at what all-in cost after the swap, and when does it mature? What is the NIM effect when it reprices or runs off?
With about 70% of the book floating and the October rate change flowing through by December, what Q3 FY27 NIM do you expect against Q2, net of the FCNR mix?

What were business-banking growth (against the 18-21% guide) and unsecured-book provision coverage (against mid-70s) in Q2 FY27? In which states is agri exposure most concentrated, given the uneven monsoon?
